query: UPDATE albums SET title = ?, sort_title = ?, display_artist = COALESCE(?, display_artist), year = COALESCE(year, ?), release_date = COALESCE(release_date, ?), album_type = COALESCE(?, album_type), track_count = COALESCE(?, track_count), file_tags = COALESCE(?, file_tags), edition = CASE WHEN ? THEN ? ELSE edition END, updated_at = ? WHERE id = ?
